title: MODERN KUNDALINI (Monday Evening) @ Lighthouse Community Yoga PDX
description: Come practice MODERN KUNDALINI *MONDAY EVENING* — a loving, trauma-sensitive Kundalini yoga class that honors your autonomy, inner wisdom, and lived experience. Each weekly session explores a different Kundalini kriya (or yogic set) and weaves together energizing movement, breathwork, meditation, an
long_description:
Come practice MODERN KUNDALINI *MONDAY EVENING* — a loving, trauma-sensitive Kundalini yoga class that honors your autonomy, inner wisdom, and lived experience. Each weekly session explores a different Kundalini kriya (or yogic set) and weaves together energizing movement, breathwork, meditation, and relaxation. The focus will be on your own sacred experience within your practice as you deepen your connection to yourSelf.

This welcoming space is designed to support practitioners of ALL LEVELS — from curious beginners to seasoned yogis. Expect the possibility of exploring new dimensions of your practice and personal journey!

ABOUT THE INSTRUCTOR: Laurel grew up with Kundalini yoga sprinkled throughout her early childhood, practiced various other forms of yoga and dance in college, and returned to her roots sometime later with the birth of her oldest son. In 2005 she studied with Gurmukh to become a certified Khalsa Way Prenatal teacher. In 2007, Laurel completed the Radiant Child teacher training with Shakta Kaur, and in 2014 she completed her Level 1 KYTT with Sevak Singh Khalsa. Laurel has a degree in Theatre, is an Equity-Informed mediator, and works in Youth Development.

Laurel has taught in many different settings over the years — schools, studios, festivals, detention centers, and university — but she continues to learn from her students and hold the core belief that we are our own wisest teacher. Laurel often incorporates poetry and dance movement into classes, which are always all-levels and intended to be accessible for all bodies and inclusive for all identities. It is her joy to share these teachings with others.

MODERN KUNDALINI with Laurel Clohessy @laurelclohessy @ Lighthouse Community Yoga PDX / EVERY MONDAY EVENING / 7:00-8:30 PM

title: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening
description: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening Classes will guide you through complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual wisdom. An ongoing in-depth course deliving into profound wisdom within Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Hindu/Indian/Vedic spiritual philosophy, and Upanishads. You can see prior recordings at: YesVedanta.com/bg2 Timeless Wisdom of Bhagavad Gita: A Complete Course in Non-Duality in 700 Verses Join us for an in-depth exploration of the Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Vedantic wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can one live with intelligence and clarity? If all existence is One, why do we perceive differences? What is the nature of the universe and its origin? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? This comprehensive study covers: The nature of the Self (Atman) and Reality (Brahman) Self-knowledge that includes dozens of methods to reveal your nature The role of karma, dharma, and free will The nature of the mind and consciousness (or awareness) The art of wise living and decision-making Cultivating emotional maturity and inner peace Through this course, you will: Grasp the core teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and their relevance to modern life Apply practical techniques for refining your thinking and mastering your emotions Develop a deeper understanding of your identity and the world Cultivate inner peace, clarity, and purpose This knowledge offers a step-by-step method to liberate the seeker from the confines of the ego, from the limitations imposed by the material world, and from the cycle of rebirth. title: Dark Divine
Pépin Lecture Series - Safar with Madhushree Ghosh
description: Join Madhushree Ghosh as she discusses her book, Safar: Finding Home, History, and Culture through Punjabi Food in the American West!
long_description:
Join Madhushree Ghosh as she discusses her book, Safar: Finding Home, History, and Culture through Punjabi Food in the American West!

About this Event

This event will be live steamed on Zoom. You can select an in-person or virtual ticket. Virtual ticket holders will receive a Zoom link prior to the event.

Madhushree Ghosh (Phd in biochemistry) is the author of Khabaar: An Immigrant Journey of Food, Memory and Family and SAFAR: Finding Home, History, and Culture through Punjabi Food in the American West. She is the creative founder of KhabaarCo, a global literary salon and supper club. As a TEDx Speaker, Madhushree interrogates cultural, culinary and immigration issues using food as a social justice tool.

Published in June of this year, Safar blends memoir and history to explore the role of Punjabi food in fostering community and identity among South Asian refugees and immigrants.

Safar follows the journey of South Asian refugees, immigrants, and their children-in particular, Sikhs, Jats, and Muslims-who moved to the southwestern states of America over centuries as farmers, truck drivers, restaurant owners, and dhaba/diner stall cooks. An expedition in search of the asli-or real Punjabi food-Madhushree Ghosh explores how their food traveled from pre-partition British India to now, while weaving in her own immigrant journey as a graduate student to America in 1993, her quest to find home through the food of her Bengali refugee parents, and the physical journey she embarked on to visit the Punjabi communities in California, Arizona, and New Mexico.

Focusing on four Punjabi women, each a part of a different immigration wave of South Asia to the American West, Ghosh highlights the food and recipes they brought with them that connect them to their pasts. Safar shares stories of displacement, discrimination, community, and hope, while shedding light on immigrant journeys and the true meaning of home, comfort food, and what constitutes a “true Punjabi” meal. About this Event

Rangili Raat is calling your name!Get ready for an unforgettable night of culture, community, and celebration! Join Nimbu Collective for Rangili Raat, a high-energy evening dedicated to celebrating Diwali and Navratri while supporting a cause that is deeply close to our hearts. Come dressed in your finest ethnic wear and get ready to experience a vibrant night filled with tradition, great music, and giving back.

What to Offer & Expect🪔 Traditional Aarti & Garba: Kick off the evening with a sacred prayer ceremony followed by an energetic open-floor Garba and Dandiya session.🎧 Live DJ Set: Dance the night away from with high-energy Bollywood hits and open-floor dancing powered by DJ Ya$h.🍲 Food & Open Bar: Enjoy delicious bites and a full open bar throughout the evening.🎨 Henna & Rangoli: Experience stunning custom rangoli installations and get beautiful designs from our on-site henna artist.✨ Special Performances & Raffles: Enjoy exclusive live performances and exciting charity raffles as part of the night's highlights.
Event Details & LogisticsDate: Thursday, October 22, 2026Time: 7:00 PM – 11:00 PMLocation: Ishq (202 Avenue A, Front A, New York, NY 10009)Dress Code: Traditional Ethnic Wear

The Heart Behind the EventThis event holds a deeply personal place in my hearts. Diwali and Navratri are my favorite holidays and are heavily celebrated in my family bringing us luck, good faith, and joy. This year, I wanted to channel that positive energy into something bigger by supporting breast cancer awareness and research. This cause is especially close to home for many, but for me it honors a beloved survivor in my family... my mother.

title: Kathak Fundamentals Dance Workshop with Pooja Ganesh (Seattle)
description: Come #DanceWithRangeela – Learn some Kathak Fundamentals choreography with Pooja!
long_description:
Come #DanceWithRangeela – Learn some Kathak Fundamentals choreography with Pooja!

About this Event

Class DescriptionJoin Pooja for this elegant Kathak fundamentals choreography class that’s perfect for all levels of dance experience! Follow us on Instagram (@rangeeladancecompany) to see the song reveal!

In-Studio ClassFor indoor training, we have a capacity limit. We ask that all participants arrive 5 MINUTES prior to class.
Meet Pooja:
Pooja has been training in Kathak for the past 13 years under Gurus Smt. Nirupama Rajendra and Shri T.D. Rajendra from Bangalore, India. She has had the privilege of performing with Abhinava Dance Company at prestigious platforms such as the Mysore Dasara Festival, Bangalore International Film Festival, ZEE5 Awards, and Alvas NudiSiri, and has been part of their esteemed productions.
She has also trained in Karanas, a special movement vocabulary of the Natyashastra, from her Guru Smt. Nirupama. Additionally, she has attended Kathak workshops conducted by legendary Gurus like Padma Bhushan Kumudini Lakhiaji and Pandit Birju Maharajji, organized by Abhinava Dance Company.
After moving to the US, Pooja continues to practice and perform under the guidance of Guru Parul Shah and Guru Smt. Nirmala Madhava (Pampa), and collaborates with other dance companies such as NDC and Naatak in the Bay Area. She has given solo recitals in New York, Seattle, New Jersey, Boston, Bay Area, Houston, Chicago, and Los Angeles.
Recently, she premiered her own work at the YUVA Festival 2023 in Houston, which was featured on Narthaki, and also presented it as a solo at Yuva Bharati, California, where it was very well received. Her collaborative work in Navatman’s Mahabharata (2021) has been selected for film festivals, and she has served as a panelist for a work-in-progress series by Prayukti Arts, California.BollyClassical

title: Diwali On The Hudson
description: Now in its 13th year, Diwali on the Hudson returns as one of New York City's largest and most anticipated Diwali celebrations. What began as an intimate community gathering has grown into a sold-out, flagship annual event, welcoming friends, professionals, creatives, and changemakers for an unforget
long_description:
Now in its 13th year, Diwali on the Hudson returns as one of New York City's largest and most anticipated Diwali celebrations. What began as an intimate community gathering has grown into a sold-out, flagship annual event, welcoming friends, professionals, creatives, and changemakers for an unforgettable night honoring the Festival of Lights, while supporting the transformative work of the Desai Foundation.

Hosted at HK Hall in the heart of Hell's Kitchen, the evening blends culture, celebration, and impact through live entertainment, Indian food, dancing, and meaningful connection with a vibrant community. Over the years, the event has welcomed celebrities, influencers, and community leaders, earning recognition from outlets including Good Morning America.

More than a party, Diwali on the Hudson is a space to gather in joy and intention, celebrating culture while learning how the Desai Foundation empowers women and children across rural India through health, livelihood, and menstrual equity programs.

About this Event

The Edina Asian American Alliance (EAAA) and 50th & France are excited to bring their annual Diwali Celebration to light on Friday, October 23, 2026.
This Festival of Lights celebration is free, family-friendly, and open to all who wish to come together as community for a weekend filled with music, dance, cultural activities, shopping, and food!
The event will be held from 6 to 8 p.m. on Friday, October 23, 2026, at The Plaza at Nolan Mains, 3945 Market St., Edina, 55424. Free parking is available in the North, Center, and South ramps.
“Diwali is meant to bring the community together to celebrate the light of life overcoming obstacles. We are excited about our partnership between EAAA and 50th & France to share the traditions of Diwali with our community,” said Raja Anton Chinnakotla (2006-2026), Founding Diwali Committee and whom the Celebration will be dedicated.
Get ready for an unforgettable evening of music and movement as local groups light up the stage with high-energy fusion numbers and traditional South Asian performances. From dynamic dance troupes to soulful singers, this kickoff will set the perfect tone for a weekend of activity and celebration.
Featured performances include:
· Bhangra Thrills
· Bharatanatyam – Nrityavidyala School of Dance
· Dhol Tasha – Marathi Association of Minnesota (MAM)
· Fazel Haris
· Mira Babal
· School of India for Languages and Culture (SILC)
· South Asian Arts & Theater House (SAATH)
Hometown leader & Mrs. Minnesota International Feroza Mehta will serve as our first-time emcee! Decorations by Artfully Nimble.
The first 200 attendees will have the opportunity to receive a specially curated treat by Lunds & Byerlys with a $5 donation toward EAAA Diwali!

About 

Kirtan is the profound and heart-centered practice of bhakti yoga that utilizes our devotional and emotional nature to draw us inward towards the Reality of our own Heart. Through the enchanting repetition of divine mantras and melodies, boundaries dissolve and a sense of unity with the Divine and fellow participants flourishes. Many are moved to embody the chants through dance and movement, which is welcomed.

Bio

Little Rishikesh Revival is inspired by the sacred spirit of Rishikesh, the revered Yoga Capital of India, home to timeless temples and ashrams and an abundance of unwavering devotion permeating its every corner. Since 2002, following a series of life-changing retreats with beloved teachers Ram Dass & Krishna Das, Tom Fuhrmann & Friends, aka Little Rishikesh Revival, has been leading kirtan in homes, yoga centers, and churches throughout the Denver-Boulder Community as well as in collaboration with many yoga retreats and peace dances.

title: Diwali at Times Square 2026
description: The largest Diwali festival outside India returns to Times Square for its 11th edition: a free full day with a Diwali Bazaar, Kids Zone, cultural performances, the Diya Lighting Ceremony and the Light Up Times Square Concert.
long_description:
Diwali at Times Square returns on Saturday, October 24, 2026, for its 11th edition, organised by Sammaan For All and presented by P&G and Tide and Toyota. The free festival takes over Broadway between 46th and 48th Streets in Manhattan.

The day opens with a Diwali Bazaar and a Kids Zone where children can paint diyas, create rangoli art and take Bollywood dance lessons, with vendor sampling and educational stalls through the day. The afternoon brings the 'Colors of India and America' programme, with performances by Indian, Indo-Caribbean and Hispanic dance groups.

In the evening, dignitaries gather for the Diya Lighting Ceremony, with a countdown on the Ball Drop Tower screen, leading into the Light Up Times Square Concert headlined by Kanika Kapoor and Raja Kumari, with Rishi Singh, Shanmukha Priya, Sparsh Shah and Kunal Lamba. Colors TV will broadcast the celebration.

Entry is free and no ticket is required. The festival weekend begins Friday, October 23 with an Awards and Gala Dinner at Tribeca 360 honouring Indian American achievers.

title: BIC Durga Pujo 2026
description: Come join us as we celebrate the biggest festival of the Bengalis.
long_description:
Come join us as we celebrate the biggest festival of the Bengalis.

About this Event

As we step into the 20th year of our Durga Puja, it’s mandatory that we look back and observe many obstacles we have overcome, how we have managed funds, and how we keep organizing the biggest event in our Bengali Culture, mostly how we have become a big joint family. For us, people of BIC, the walls of MM Thompson Room has become the bamboo pandal, the drawings and stuffs made by our decoration team have became the chandelier of Naktala Udayan Sangha, the YouTube Red “dhaak” music has became our real dhaki, sometimes a little snow didn’t stop us to believe that we are enjoying the Sarotkal, like Apu-Durga, we are also chasing though the kaashful and trying to soak up every bit of it. Such power holds this event, such is the power of Maa Durga! অশুভ শক্তির বিনাস, triumph over evil, she make us believe in ourselves, the truth and strength. Every year we bid our Maa Durga farewell with the hope that she’ll bring new virtue within us and she’ll visit us next year.

description: Learn how to the flavors found in Indian cuisine in your own kitchen. Hands-on. For ages 18+. You’ll work in small teams during class.
long_description:
Learn how to the flavors found in Indian cuisine in your own kitchen. Hands-on. For ages 18+. You’ll work in small teams during class.

About this Event

Age RestrictionsFor ages 18 & up

DescriptionIf you love Indian food and have wondered how to recreate those flavors in your own home, this is the class for you! While the South Asian/Indian culinary diaspora is incredibly diverse, we’re here to lessen the intimidation factor and help you get to know the key spices, knife skills, essential sauces, and cooking methods to get you started.
We’ll pay homage to Madhur Jaffrey, multiple James Beard Award-winner known as the Godmother of Indian Cooking for introducing many people to Indian food in America. Using her approach, we’ll keep class fun, easy, and delicious at every turn. At the end of class everyone will get to sit down and enjoy a meal together.
You will be working in a small group. For ages 18 and up. 21 or older? You’ll enjoy a glass of wine or beer paired with your meal.

MenuLamb Vindaloo
Shahi Murgh (Royal Chicken Cooked in Yogurt)
Massor Dal (Red Lentils Tarka)
Matar Aur Sooay Ka Pullao (Rice with Peas and Dill)
Hari Chutney (Fresh Green Chutney)
Sev ka Murabba (Carmelized Cardamom Apples with Pistachio Cream)

Safety & Precautions
At check-in, you will be asked to sign a waiver before entering the Cooking School.
For that reason, we ask that all attendees arrive at least 5 minutes prior to the confirmed start time of the class.

About the book: (OUT 10/13/26; Available for pre-order with your ticket or at Birch Tree)

A speculative horror-romance that combines the magical dark academia of The Atlas Six, the unsettling atmosphere of Mexican Gothic, and the psychosexual power dynamics of The Last Housewife.

Saige Chambers, Arcane Bioengineering student and blood witch, is constantly anxious and chronically over-prepared. When Saige and her fellow witch doctoral candidates depart for a conference, she plans and anticipates every last detail. Except she’s not prepared for the moment their bus turns off the highway and takes them to a remote mansion in the Appalachian Mountains, the gates sealing shut behind them.

The mansion’s owner, Arius Medea, issues a simple mandate: fix his injured, rotting leg or die. But it’s no ordinary injury—the flesh melts off the bone, emitting waves of foul magic that set Saige’s blood alight. Saige’s colleagues want to fight back and escape. Saige thinks their best chance is to fix him fast and get out.

As tensions rise, Saige finds herself growing closer to Vaishnavi Sri, a poison witch and Saige’s long-term crush. But first impressions can be misleading, and as Saige’s reluctant attraction to Arius grows, she begins to wonder if there’s a better life waiting for her in the walls of this mansion.

Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can one live with intelligence and clarity? If all existence is One, why do we perceive differences? What is the nature of the universe and its origin? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? This comprehensive study covers: The nature of the Self (Atman) and Reality (Brahman) Self-knowledge that includes dozens of methods to reveal your nature The role of karma, dharma, and free will The nature of the mind and consciousness (or awareness) The art of wise living and decision-making Cultivating emotional maturity and inner peace Through this course, you will: Grasp the core teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and their relevance to modern life Apply practical techniques for refining your thinking and mastering your emotions Develop a deeper understanding of your identity and the world Cultivate inner peace, clarity, and purpose This knowledge offers a step-by-step method to liberate the seeker from the confines of the ego, from the limitations imposed by the material world, and from the cycle of rebirth. description: Learn how to the flavors found in Indian cuisine in your own kitchen. Hands-on. For ages 18+. You’ll work in small teams during class.
long_description:
Learn how to the flavors found in Indian cuisine in your own kitchen. Hands-on. For ages 18+. You’ll work in small teams during class.

About this Event

Age RestrictionsFor ages 18 & up

DescriptionIf you love Indian food and have wondered how to recreate those flavors in your own home, this is the class for you! While the South Asian/Indian culinary diaspora is incredibly diverse, we’re here to lessen the intimidation factor and help you get to know the key spices, knife skills, essential sauces, and cooking methods to get you started.
We’ll pay homage to Madhur Jaffrey, multiple James Beard Award-winner known as the Godmother of Indian Cooking for introducing many people to Indian food in America. Using her approach, we’ll keep class fun, easy, and delicious at every turn. At the end of class everyone will get to sit down and enjoy a meal together.

Shop our Diwali Bazaar, enjoy live performances, discover festive treasures, and make wonderful memories with family, friends, and neighbors. More exciting vendor and performer announcements are coming!
❤️ A New Home. A New Beginning. A Bigger Family! This Diwali is especially meaningful as ParivarBayArea celebrates its new chapter as an independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit and welcomes everyone to our new home at St. Mark's Square & Urban Life Center. Founded and led by the Kinnar-Hijrah community, rooted in Indian and South Asian heritage, and shaped by Global South immigrant experiences, we continue to grow while honoring our roots. We welcome immigrant families, elders, youth, LGBTQ+ communities, neighbors, and people of every faith, identity, and background. You don't have to be South Asian or Hindu to celebrate, and you don't have to spend Diwali alone. Come find your Parivar—your family!
🎉 Sunday, November 8, 2026 | 6:30–9:30 PM | St. Mark's Square, 1031 Franklin Street, San Francisco. Come dressed in your brightest festive colors, traditional attire, or simply as you are! title: Quick & Easy Indian Cooking
description: Learn how to the flavors found in Indian cuisine in your own kitchen. Hands-on. For ages 18+. You’ll work in small teams during class.
long_description:
Learn how to the flavors found in Indian cuisine in your own kitchen. Hands-on. For ages 18+. You’ll work in small teams during class.

About this Event

Age RestrictionsFor ages 18 & up

DescriptionIf you love Indian food and have wondered how to recreate those flavors in your own home, this is the class for you! While the South Asian/Indian culinary diaspora is incredibly diverse, we’re here to lessen the intimidation factor and help you get to know the key spices, knife skills, essential sauces, and cooking methods to get you started.
We’ll pay homage to Madhur Jaffrey, multiple James Beard Award-winner known as the Godmother of Indian Cooking for introducing many people to Indian food in America. Using her approach, we’ll keep class fun, easy, and delicious at every turn. At the end of class everyone will get to sit down and enjoy a meal together.
You will be working in a small group. For ages 18 and up. 21 or older? You’ll enjoy a glass of wine or beer paired with your meal.

MenuLamb Vindaloo
Shahi Murgh (Royal Chicken Cooked in Yogurt)
Massor Dal (Red Lentils Tarka)
Matar Aur Sooay Ka Pullao (Rice with Peas and Dill)
Hari Chutney (Fresh Green Chutney)
Sev ka Murabba (Carmelized Cardamom Apples with Pistachio Cream)

Safety & Precautions
At check-in, you will be asked to sign a waiver before entering the Cooking School.
For that reason, we ask that all attendees arrive at least 5 minutes prior to the confirmed start time of the class.

Bhangra & Beats returns to Yerba Buena Gardens for a special Diwali edition. Join us for an unforgettable evening as Yerba Buena Gardens, Jessie Square, and Yerba Buena Lane glow with the vibrant sights, sounds, flavors, and spirit of South Asian culture as we celebrate Diwali, the Festival of Lights.
At the heart of it all is the joyful Bhangra & Beats experience—a family-friendly celebration where traditional Punjabi rhythms meet Bay Area energy. Non Stop Bhangra will once again lead the festivities with its signature mix of interactive dance lessons, vibrant performances, live dhol drumming, DJs, and an open dance floor, alongside a lively night market featuring local food vendors, artisans, community activations, family-friendly activities, and special offerings from neighborhood restaurants and bars.
Diwali celebrates light over darkness, hope, renewal, and the triumph of good over evil. Whether you're celebrating with family and friends or experiencing the Festival of Lights for the first time, everyone is welcome to come dance, connect, and celebrate together in the heart of San Francisco.

Experience the Vibrance of Punjabi Culture at the Boston Bhangra Competition
Mark your calendars for the 14th of November, 2026 as the city of Boston comes alive with the infectious energy and vibrant colors of the Boston Bhangra Competition. The Strand Theatre will be pulsating with the rhythmic beats of Bhangra, a Punjabi dance form, as the best teams from across North America showcase their talent. Organized by the South Asian Nation, this multilingual event is an absolute treat for lovers of dance and music.
Unleashing the Power of Dance with No Boundaries
The Boston Bhangra Competition does not feature a specific artist, instead, it is a platform where numerous talented artists come together to celebrate and promote the Punjabi culture. Each team brings a unique take on the traditional Bhangra, captivating the audience with their high-energy performances. It is not just a competition, but a celebration of diversity, unity, and the rich cultural heritage of Punjab.
Immerse in the Cultural Extravaganza at Strand Theatre
The event will take place at the historic Strand Theatre, located at 543 Columbia Rd Dorchester, Boston, MA, United States. The venue is well-known for its safety and easy accessibility. It's an ideal location to enjoy the rhythmic beats of Bhangra. The venue is surrounded by a number of Indian restaurants, perfect for grabbing a quick bite before or after the event. Parking is also available for those who prefer to drive.
Secure Your Seats Today!
Tickets are available in various tiers to suit everyone's budget. VIP tickets are priced at $100.00 for those who want an exclusive experience. Tier 1 tickets are available at $50.00, Tier 2 at $40.00, Tier 3 at $30.00, Tier 4 at $25.00, and Tier 5 at $20.00. Additionally, dinner tickets can be purchased for $15.00. title: Silent Disco at Domain: Bollywood, Tollywood, & Everything in Between
description: Get ready to dance the night away with silent beats from Bollywood to Tollywood and all the cool vibes underneath the stary night!
long_description:
Get ready to dance the night away with silent beats from Bollywood to Tollywood and all the cool vibes underneath the stary night!

About this Event

Headphones on, Austin. Bollywood, Tollywood and everything in between, at The Domain, Amy Donovan Plaza.
Overview
When the sun goes down on Panchabhootam, the plaza turns into a dance floor.
Join SAIVA on Saturday, November 14, from 8:30 to 9:30 PM for a silent disco at The Domain's Amy Donovan Plaza. Bollywood, Tollywood, and everything in between, playing straight into your headphones under the open Texas sky.
This is the closing celebration of Panchabhootam, SAIVA's festival of the five great elements: earth, water, fire, air and space. All afternoon, the elements come alive through the senses. The silent disco ends the day with sound, the sense of space, and everyone dancing together.
At SAIVA, we believe every generation has something to give and something to learn. So bring your grandmother, your kids, your college roommate and your neighbors. Some of our best dancers have been practicing in our weekly classes since May.
How it works
When you arrive, you'll pick up a pair of wireless headphones. 3 channels each play a different mix, and the light on your headset shows which one you're tuned to, so you can find the people dancing to your song.
Want to talk? Slide one ear off. No shouting over speakers, and no ringing ears on the drive home. It's the most social way to dance.
Make a day of it
Come early for the free Panchabhootam festival from 3 to 6 PM at the same plaza:
Experience the elementsDance performancesSeed ball creation, art, and fermentation activitiesFood for purchase and a marketFamily activities for all agesGood to know

title: Seat at the Table: South Asians Rise in American Politics - Film and Talk
venue_name: The City College of New York
description: Seat at the Table documents the rise of South Asian Americans in U.S. politics, tracing their  journey from the margins towards power.
long_description:
Seat at the Table documents the rise of South Asian Americans in U.S. politics, tracing their journey from the margins towards power.

About this Event

Seat at the Table follows several prominent South Asian political candidates during the 2024 election cycle, alongside a community galvanized by the groundbreaking campaign of the first South Asian presidential candidate. Within a hundred years, South Asians in America have gone from being disenfranchised, to seeing the first South Asian presidential candidate on a major party’s ticket.
Join us to see thsi film and hear from the filmmakers and others on rise of South Asians in this arena. 
When: Thursday, Nov 19th at 6 PM
Where: City College of NY, Shepard Hall, Room 291 (second floor)
259 Convent Avenue at 140th Street (SE Corner) ID needed to enter the building.
To get there: #1 to 137th street, ABCD to 145th Street. Accessible mode: #6 to 125th Street, M101 to 140th street. 
Building and theater is accessible. CART available. Light Refreshments.
Presented by Third World Newsrteel, the Documentary Forum at CCNY and AAARI (Asian American/Asian Research Institute at CUNY)

With unprecedented access to congressional and state-level campaigns, as well as grassroots organizing efforts, the film captures a historic year for the South Asian diaspora as more candidates than ever run for office, providing us a rare front-row seat to an immigrant community awakening to its power in America.

Maybe you don't yoga. Or pilates. But you love animals and want to just chill with goats? Join us for a heartwarming and joy-filled experience!

You can arrive anytime between 2-3 PM.

Similar to the Japanese practice of spending mindful, therapeutic time sitting or walking in nature - Shinrin-yoku, which literally translates to "forest bathing". Developed in the 1980s, the practice involves immersing yourself in the forest atmosphere and engaging with nature through all five of your senses. Welcome to the goat forest!

Our distinguished Key Speakers include the charming goats - Nigerian Dwarf and Mini Silky Fainting ready to share their love and positive energy with all attendees.

Escape the routine and immerse yourself in a therapy session with nature. Whether you prefer to nap or play there's something for everyone. Simply relax in a lawn chair or hammock cuddle with a goat and watch your worries fade away. Feel the magic as time slips by and anxiety melts away in the serene farm setting.

This event is family-friendly so bring your loved ones and make cherished memories together. Please remember to bring your own beverage as our furry friends have a penchant for nibbling on snacks!

Secure your tickets now through AllEvents and treat yourself to a one-of-a-kind experience that promises to destress and uplift your spirits. Say goodbye to holiday blues and hello to pure joy at "Cuddle with Goats and Puppies and Ducks on the Farm in Rockwall."

title: Special Program: Counter-Histories—Memory, Materiality & South Asian Art
description: Syona Puliady and UCLA Arts Dean Lionel Popkin discuss South Asian art, material, memory, and reimagined histories.
long_description:
Syona Puliady and UCLA Arts Dean Lionel Popkin discuss South Asian art, material, memory, and reimagined histories.

About this Event

Curator of Textiles of the Eastern Hemisphere Syona Puliady will join UCLA Dean of the School of the Arts and Architecture Lionel Popkin for a conversation on the themes underlying Textiles as Monument and Field Notes from Begumpura: memory, materiality, and the creation of alternative histories through contemporary art.

By focusing on the works of Suchitra Mattai, Jagdeep Raina, Swapnaa Tamhane, and Rahee Punyashloka, Puliady and Popkin will consider how artists use textiles, speculative storytelling, archival practices, and other forms of cultural expression to challenge dominant narratives and center communities whose histories have often been overlooked. Together, they will address how contemporary South Asian artists create new forms of remembrance, belonging, and possibility through material and imagined worlds.

Lionel Popkin is the dean of the UCLA School of the Arts and Architecture and a professor of choreography in the UCLA Department of World Arts and Cultures/Dance. He previously served as the school’s associate dean for academic affairs (2021–24) and chair of the World Arts and Cultures/Dance department (2015–18). Popkin’s artistic practice engages people, objects, and media to explore hybridity, archival practices, and the complexities of representing the South Asian diaspora in North America. His performance and video artworks have been presented at leading cultural venues on four continents, and his written works have been included in scholarly journals and arts publications. He joined UCLA's faculty in 2006 and is a resident artist at the 18th Street Arts Center.

Syona Puliady is curator of textiles of the Eastern Hemisphere at the Fowler Museum. Her research focuses on histories and textiles of the Indian Ocean realm. Her work also takes her to the South Indian state of Tamil Nadu, where she collaborates with art

title: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening
description: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening Classes will guide you through complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual wisdom. An ongoing in-depth course deliving into profound wisdom within Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Hindu/Indian/Vedic spiritual philosophy, and Upanishads. You can see prior recordings at: YesVedanta.com/bg2 Timeless Wisdom of Bhagavad Gita: A Complete Course in Non-Duality in 700 Verses Join us for an in-depth exploration of the Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Vedantic wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can one live with intelligence and clarity? If all existence is One, why do we perceive differences? What is the nature of the universe and its origin? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? This comprehensive study covers: The nature of the Self (Atman) and Reality (Brahman) Self-knowledge that includes dozens of methods to reveal your nature The role of karma, dharma, and free will The nature of the mind and consciousness (or awareness) The art of wise living and decision-making Cultivating emotional maturity and inner peace Through this course, you will: Grasp the core teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and their relevance to modern life Apply practical techniques for refining your thinking and mastering your emotions Develop a deeper understanding of your identity and the world Cultivate inner peace, clarity, and purpose This knowledge offers a step-by-step method to liberate the seeker from the confines of the ego, from the limitations imposed by the material world, and from the cycle of rebirth. Experience a Night of Musical Magic with Udit Narayan & Aditya Narayan
Prepare to be enchanted this
28th of November, 2026
, as Udit Narayan & Aditya Narayan grace the stage in Detroit for a live concert like no other. Immerse yourself in an unforgettable evening filled with soulful Hindi melodies as this dynamic father-son duo takes you on a musical journey. This is a must-attend for music enthusiasts seeking a genuine "Live in Concert" experience.
Meet the Maestros - Udit Narayan & Aditya Narayan
Stepping into the spotlight is the legendary
Udit Narayan
, a Nepalese playback singer whose enchanting voice has been featured in countless Nepali and Hindi movies. Known affectionately as Uditji, his repertoire also includes songs in Kannada, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Punjabi, Oriya, Assamese, and Bengali. Performing alongside him is his equally talented son, Aditya Narayan, ensuring an evening of captivating performances that will leave you spellbound.
Your Destination - Detroit Music Hall Center
The concert will be held at the esteemed
Detroit Music Hall Center
, located at 350 Madison St, Detroit, MI, United States. Known for its safety and accessibility, the venue is nestled in the heart of Detroit, surrounded by popular attractions. Parking is available for your convenience. And to complete your evening, why not indulge in some authentic Indian cuisine? There are numerous Indian restaurants in the vicinity to choose from.
Secure Your Seats - Ticket Information
Make sure you don't miss out on this spectacular event by securing your tickets now. Choose from a range of options to suit your preferences. For the ultimate experience, opt for the Elite ticket priced at $500.00. VIP tickets are available at $300.00. Additional levels at $210.00, $179.00, $169.00, $129.00, $99.00, $79.00, and $69.00 are also available, ensuring there's an option for every budget. Don't wait, book your tickets now for an unforgettable evening with Udit Narayan & Aditya Narayan.

Millennial Events presents Ghayal, a brand-new Hindi stand-up comedy show by Pranit More.

In Ghayal, Pranit takes audiences through the journey of his life—the people, places, relationships, and unexpected incidents that have shaped his personality and the way he sees the world. From growing up and navigating everyday life to the unforgettable moments that made headlines, Pranit brings his experiences to the stage through candid storytelling, sharp observations, and his distinctive comedic style.

Personal, honest, and packed with humour, Ghayal offers audiences a closer look at the stories behind the comedian. Whether they have followed Pranit’s journey for years or are seeing him perform live for the first time, audiences can expect an entertaining evening filled with stories, surprises, and stand-up comedy.

Whether you’re planning a night out with friends, family, or attending solo, this high-energy live performance promises nonstop entertainment and moments you’ll be talking about long after the show ends. If you’re looking to unwind and enjoy quality comedy, you won’t want to miss this show.

description:
New York City's #1 live South Asian comedy dating show.
Real singles. Real sparks. Real chaos. Live in Philly!
long_description:
New York City's #1 live South Asian comedy dating show.

Real singles. Real sparks. Real chaos. Live in Philly!

About this Event

Garam Masala : #1 Desi Dating Show
Sunday December 6, 2026
Showtime 6:30PM, Doors 6PM
Running time 80 minutes

How the Night WorksImagine The Bachelor meets Indian Matchmaking, but live on stage hosted by two comedians who are deeply unqualified and absolutely thriving.
Garam Masala Dating is NYC's #1 live desi dating show where South Asian singles go on a blind date in front of a packed house. Our hosts Surbhi and Wyatt guide the chaos with stand-up, crowd work, and genuine matchmaking instincts. Every show ends with a singles mixer where the audience gets to continue the experiment.
Whether you're South Asian or not, curious, single, coupled up, or just need a story, this is the most fun you'll have watching two people fall in love (or spectacularly not) in real time.

About Next In Line Comedy Club:
Located in Philadelphia's Spring Garden neighborhood. 1025 Hamilton Street.
21+ unless with parent or guardian.
Tonights show is BYOB. There is a brewery next door for convenience!
Door and showtimes may adjust slightly based on event logistics or performer needs.
Lineups may shift due to the nature of live comedy and performer availability.
Shows run approximately 80 minutes.
We don't sell food.
Parking: There is paid parking next door or street parking if you can find it.
Please note: This venue is not wheelchair accessible.

description: Internet Marketing Fundamentals 1-Day Workshop - Grand Prairie, TX Dive into the basics of internet marketing and level up your skills in this fun, one-day hands-on training session! This one-day Internet Marketing Fundamentals Workshop gives participants the essential skills to build a strong online presence, attract the right audience, and convert leads into customers. From understanding your brand’s strengths using a structured SWOT framework to leveraging SEO, social media, web content, online campaigns, and lead generation tactics—this workshop covers the core pillars of modern digital marketing. Designed for beginners, business owners, marketers, freelancers, and anyone wanting to grow online, this training blends strategy with action-oriented tools you can start using immediately. By the end of the session, you’ll know how to create impactful content, design optimized web pages, run engaging campaigns, and build a consistent digital brand. This course is highly relevant for anyone looking to improve online visibility, increase website traffic, and strengthen digital communication skills.

title: BMW Dallas Marathon 2026
description: Dallas's premier marathon weekend with full marathon, half, ultra, 5K, and relay options. Benefits Scottish Rite for Children.
long_description: The BMW Dallas Marathon has been a Texas running tradition for over 40 years. The race weekend features a full marathon, half marathon, ultra marathon, 5-person relay, 10K, and 5K — something for every runner. The course starts at Dallas City Hall, loops through scenic White Rock Lake, and finishes back downtown. Since 1997, the marathon has donated nearly $5 million to Scottish Rite for Children. The December timing provides cool running weather, and the event has sold out three consecutive years.
venue_info: Start/finish at Dallas City Hall, 1500 Marilla St. The course is flat and fast, passing through downtown Dallas and around White Rock Lake (120m total elevation gain). DART light rail serves the City Hall area. Post-race party with food, beer, and live music.

title: Quick & Easy Indian Cooking
description: Learn how to the flavors found in Indian cuisine in your own kitchen. Hands-on. For ages 18+. You’ll work in small teams during class.
long_description:
Learn how to the flavors found in Indian cuisine in your own kitchen. Hands-on. For ages 18+. You’ll work in small teams during class.

About this Event

Age RestrictionsFor ages 18 & up

DescriptionIf you love Indian food and have wondered how to recreate those flavors in your own home, this is the class for you! While the South Asian/Indian culinary diaspora is incredibly diverse, we’re here to lessen the intimidation factor and help you get to know the key spices, knife skills, essential sauces, and cooking methods to get you started.
We’ll pay homage to Madhur Jaffrey, multiple James Beard Award-winner known as the Godmother of Indian Cooking for introducing many people to Indian food in America. Using her approach, we’ll keep class fun, easy, and delicious at every turn. At the end of class everyone will get to sit down and enjoy a meal together.
You will be working in a small group. For ages 18 and up. 21 or older? You’ll enjoy a glass of wine or beer paired with your meal.

MenuLamb Vindaloo
Shahi Murgh (Royal Chicken Cooked in Yogurt)
Massor Dal (Red Lentils Tarka)
Matar Aur Sooay Ka Pullao (Rice with Peas and Dill)
Hari Chutney (Fresh Green Chutney)
Sev ka Murabba (Carmelized Cardamom Apples with Pistachio Cream)

Safety & Precautions
At check-in, you will be asked to sign a waiver before entering the Cooking School.
For that reason, we ask that all attendees arrive at least 5 minutes prior to the confirmed start time of the class.

title: San Diego Tamil Sangam Annual Membership 2026
description: Experience the Vibrance of Tamil Culture at the San Diego Tamil Sangam Annual Membership 2026
long_description:
Experience the Vibrance of Tamil Culture at the San Diego Tamil Sangam Annual Membership 2026
Mark your calendars for December 31st, 2026, as on this day, the San Diego Tamil Sangam will host its highly anticipated Annual Membership event. A cultural extravaganza that celebrates the richness and diversity of Tamil heritage, this event is a golden opportunity for Tamil enthusiasts to come together and revel in the vibrancy of this ancient culture. The event is sure to be a hub of engagement, enrichment, and entertainment that fosters the promotion and preservation of Tamil language, arts, and literature.
Artist: A Secret Yet to be Revealed
The event is yet to announce its artist, but it's known for featuring renowned individuals from the Tamil community who have significantly influenced the preservation and promotion of Tamil culture. The mystery guest, no doubt, will offer a memorable experience, showcasing the beauty of Tamil arts and literature that resonates with the audience and deepens their appreciation for this rich culture.
Immerse Yourself in Tamil Culture in the Heart of San Diego
The event takes place in San Diego, California, specifically at the 750 B Street location. The venue is in an easily accessible area of the city, known for its safety and proximity to a variety of attractions. After the event, guests can explore the city's vibrant nightlife, historical landmarks, and breathtaking beaches. And for those craving authentic Indian cuisine, there are numerous Indian restaurants nearby where you can indulge in a variety of flavorful dishes.
Secure Your Membership: Ticket Information
Various membership options are available for purchase, ensuring there's something for everyone. The Annual Family Membership is priced at $60.00, providing an excellent opportunity for families to be part of the Tamil community in San Diego. The Annual Individual Membership is available for $35.00, perfect for individuals passionate about Tamil culture. Additionally, the Student Membership from India is priced at a discounted rate of $10.00. For those who want to make a long-term commitment, the Lifetime Membership is available for $500.00. Make sure to secure your membership and be part of the San Diego Tamil Sangam's thriving community.

long_description:
Usama Siddiquee is a Bengali-American stand-up comedian, writer, and actor based in New York City. He is currently a finalist on Kevin Hart’s Funny AF for Netflix, which premiered on April 20. In 2024, he made his late-night debut on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, and in 2025 released his first half-hour special with Don’t Tell Comedy on YouTube. The special highlights his signature high-energy, rapid-fire style, with material ranging from growing up Muslim in Texas to dating misadventures and even getting kicked off America’s Got Talent.

As an actor, Usama has appeared in Netflix’s Inventing Anna and Survival of the Thickest, HBO’s And Just Like That, Comedy Central’s Awkwafina Is Nora from Queens, and FX’s Better Things. He recently wrapped a supporting role in the upcoming Netflix comedy Best of the Best, alongside Hasan Minhaj, Priyanka Kedia, and Maitreyi Ramakrishnan.

Usama was named a New Face at the prestigious Just For Laughs Festival in 2018. In 2020, he reached the semifinals of America’s Got Talent and appeared in the ABC Discovers Talent Showcase. A decorated festival performer, he was a finalist in the 2017 New York’s Funniest competition at Caroline’s and the NBC Stand-Up competition, and has won top honors at the Laughing Devil Cup Comedy Festival (2016), Yonkers Comedy Festival (2015), and Make Me Laugh Albany Comedy Festival (2015). His work has also been featured by NBC, BuzzFeed, Refinery29, The Scene, Mic.com, FusionTV, and The Huffington Post.
